arena_specification.cover_mechanic: Blocks line-of-sight raycasts and projectile trajectories 100%.

4.name: Shoot
4.description: Discharges a projectile toward the opponent along line of sight. Consumes 1 ammo.

5.name: Move to Cover
5.description: Navigates agent toward the nearest defensible barrier to break line of sight.

6.name: Retreat
6.description: Moves agent directly away from the opponent to increase distance.

policy_signals_explanation.V_s: Critic state-value estimate V(s) represents expected cumulative discounted reward from current state. Negative values indicate disadvantageous states.
policy_signals_explanation.pi_a_s: Actor probability distribution pi(a|s) across all 7 discrete actions. Represents the policy's preference confidence at that exact decision frame.
